name: Sumanth Narem
tagline: Building across full-stack, DevOps, cloud, and AI.
bio: Sumanth Narem is a software engineer who builds end-to-end: from infrastructure and deployment pipelines to full-stack applications and, more recently, agentic AI systems. At Rever, he works across the stack, from Next.js and SEO on the frontend to Django and FastAPI on the backend, with self-hosted deployments on Docker Compose and Kubernetes via Helm, provisioned with AWS CloudFormation. Before that, he shipped MERN and React Native products at Design Blocks, and built React applications at The Entrepreneurship Network. He is currently learning retrieval-augmented generation, infrastructure as code at scale, and applied LLM evaluation. This portfolio itself is proof of the approach: a RAG-backed AI twin, grounded in verified, version-controlled data instead of freeform hallucination.
